sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A large tropical American tree, often 25–35 m tall, with a broad spreading crown. Its leaves are bipinnate and its small flowers are grouped in spherical heads.

sections.title: Fruit and seeds
sections.text: The thick, leathery pod curls into a distinctive ring resembling an ear. It contains several seeds.

sections.title: Caution
sections.text: Livestock poisoning from the fruits has been reported. Human uses mentioned in some sources do not establish that the seeds or pods are safe; no consumption is recommended here.
